title: Wanted Felon On Motorcycle Leads Police Down Bumpy Dirt Road Before Crashing
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Genesee County, Michigan — On Saturday, July 12, 2025, Grand Blanc Township Police Officers engaged in a high-risk pursuit of a fleeing motorcyclist who turned out to be a wanted felon in multiple states. The Officers  apprehended the individual ending this pursuit.
